vars.query: UNWIND [1, 1] AS input MATCH (s:MultiExpansionRoot {name: 'root'}) WITH s MATCH p = (s)-[:Okta_MemberOf|Okta_HasRoleAssignment*1..2]->(t) RETURN p
MATCH (s:MultiExpansionRoot {name: 'root'})-[:Okta_MemberOf|Okta_HasRoleAssignment*1..2]->(t) SET t.selected = true RETURN t
UNWIND [1, 1] AS input MATCH (s:MultiExpansionRoot {name: 'root'}) WITH s MATCH p = (s)-[:Okta_MemberOf|Okta_HasRoleAssignment*1..3]->(t) RETURN p
MATCH (s:MultiExpansionRoot {name: 'root'})-[:Okta_MemberOf|Okta_HasRoleAssignment*1..3]->(t) SET t.selected = true RETURN t

variants.name: three hop trails preserve node revisits and reject relationship reuse
